intro: You are visiting an office with your class. Introduce yourself politely to the manager.

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Good morning! Welcome to our office. Please introduce yourself.

conversation.speaker: student
expected: Good morning, my name is Arjun.

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Nice to meet you. What would you like to become in the future?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what you want to become.
expected: I want to become a doctor.
I would like to be an engineer.
I want to be a teacher.
conversation.hint: Try: "I want to become a doctor."

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: That is a wonderful goal. Why did you choose it?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Give a reason for your choice.
expected: Because I want to help people.
conversation.hint: Try: "Because I want to help people."

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Excellent thinking. Do you have any questions about our work?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask the manager a question about the office.
expected: What work do you do here?
conversation.hint: Try: "What work do you do here?"

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: We design software for schools. Study hard and you could join us one day!

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Thank the manager and say goodbye.
